EN EN EN | FR FR FR Leading the Future of Traffic Solutions Providing cutting edge Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and Traffic Control Devices for safer, smarter and more efficient roadways. Traffic infrastructure is essential for safe and efficient cities That's where Tacel comes in. AT TACEL Tacel is a Canadian owned company specializing in traffic control systems and intelligent transportation solutions. Since 1979, we have been at the forefront of traffic engineering innovation, providing cutting edge products and expert services to municipalities, contractors, and consulting engineers across Canada. Collaboration At Tacel, collaboration is the cornerstone of our success. Our teams work cohesively across departments and with industry-leading partners to deliver comprehensive traffic solutions. This synergy is evident in our partnerships with companies like Applied Information and Sensys Networks, enabling us to provide cutting-edge technologies such as Connected Vehicle solutions and advanced detection systems. Commitment Our unwavering commitment to quality and safety is demonstrated through our ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System, ensuring that our operations meet the highest standards. Being 100% Canadian-owned and operated, we take pride in serving communities across the nation, tailoring our solutions to meet diverse regional needs. Determination Tacel's determination drives us to tackle complex challenges in traffic management. Our expansion into Smart City technologies, including Emergency Vehicle Preemption and Transit Signal Priority systems, showcases our proactive approach to enhancing road safety and efficiency. Passion Passion fuels our innovation and dedication to improving transportation infrastructure. Our team is deeply invested in developing solutions that make communities safer and more accessible.
